approved_direction.material: 玫瑰紫强流动 Liquid Glass
approved_direction.motion: A 折射涟漪 + E 磁吸浮起
approved_direction.petals: A 稀疏慢落，背景层，默认低强度，可关闭

component_contracts.content_lens: Dark translucent layers preserve text contrast above decorative material.
component_contracts.edge_handle: Theme-colored vertical handle; right by default, draggable to left.
component_contracts.icons: Simple single-color system icons; independent 花 mark for tray and installer icon.
component_contracts.record_row: Stable 52px class height, type icon, primary content, metadata, pin/favorite state.
component_contracts.settings: Unframed two-column settings window with appearance, motion, input, clipboard, privacy, behavior, displays, and system sections.

interaction_contracts.middle_click: Intercept only after the cursor panel opens successfully; excluded apps retain native middle-click behavior.
interaction_contracts.single_click: Copy the selected record and hide the cursor panel after success.
interaction_contracts.double_click_or_enter: Copy, return focus to the originating window, paste, then hide; preserve clipboard content and show recovery guidance if paste fails.

prohibited_variations: petals above text or record cards
